name: Flicker
description: Teleports a short distance in the target direction.

name: Purify
description: Immediately removes all CC effects, grants CC immunity and +15% Movement Speed for 1.2s.
best_against: Heavy CC chains (Tigreal, Atlas, Badang, Guinevere, Chou, Franco)

name: Retribution
description: Mandatory spell for Jungler. Deals true damage to creeps and objectives.

name: Inspire
description: Significantly enhances basic attack speed (up to 500%), ignores defense, and grants HP heal.
best_against: High attack speed marksmen (Miya, Moskov, Wanwan)

name: Vengeance
description: Reflects 35% damage taken and grants 35% damage reduction for 3s.
best_against: High attack speed and physical burst (Claude, Miya, Badang)

name: Sprint
description: Grants +50% movement speed and slow immunity for 6s.

name: Petrify
description: Stuns nearby enemies for 0.8s and slows them by 50%.
best_against: Close-combat burst combos (Benedetta, Yu Zhong, Kadita)

name: Aegis
description: Grants a shield for 3s to self and the lowest HP nearby ally.

name: Revitalize
description: Summons a healing spring that recovers HP over 5s.

name: Flameshot
description: Snipes enemies at long range or knocks back close attackers.

name: Arrival
description: Teleports to allied turret or minion, enhancing defense.

name: Execute
description: Deals true damage based on lost HP; CD reduced by 40% on kill.
